prompt: Create a high-angle dramatic fisheye lens photograph at night, shot from directly above with extreme wide-angle distortion and a circular black vignette around the frame. In the center of a wet urban crosswalk, a young East Asian woman looks straight up into the camera with an intense, slightly surprised expression. She is holding one pair of oversized glossy black sunglasses very close to the lens with her left hand, so the sunglasses dominate the upper foreground and partially cover her forehead and eyes, creating a surreal forced-perspective effect; raindrops and reflections should be visible on the lenses. She has wet, slightly messy dark hair with bangs, natural makeup, large reflective eyes, and dewy skin. Her outfit is a beige ribbed cropped camisole with thin straps, loose blue jeans, white sneakers, and a delicate necklace. The setting is a rain-soaked city street in a dense downtown district with bold black-and-white zebra crossing stripes beneath her, glossy asphalt, puddle reflections, blurred car headlights in the distance, streetlights flaring, traffic signals, storefront lights, and tall dark buildings on both sides. Use a cinematic nighttime color palette with cool blacks and blues, warm streetlight highlights, high contrast, realistic skin texture, sharp foreground detail, slight background motion blur, and the look of a spontaneous flash street-fashion photo taken with a fisheye action camera. Vertical portrait composition, immersive perspective, no text, no watermark.
